title: radiation: extra materials
description: volgurite, uranium, nether diamond, enderite. 4 minerals, 4 ores, new tools and armor, radiation, and the merge dimension, GO! yes this might be buggy as this is my first project
body:
This project is just for fun, and it most solely relies on 4 new elements - Volgurite, Uranium, Nether Diamond, and Enderite (Nww elements coming soon)
**THIS MOD ONLY WORKS ON NEOFORGE**
(I couldn't really find a Fabric mod for Mcreator that supports my version, so I used NeoForge instead)

But why would you want to download this mod? Well, like I said, this mod is just for fun and if you want to spice up your game a little bit.

## Anyways, here's what the project adds so far:

New Ores and Blocks:
Volgurite (Has all tools except Shovel [coming soon], Hoe, and Spear)
Uranium
Nether Diamond (Has all tools except Shovel [coming soon], Hoe, and Spear)
Enderite 

Misc Weapons:
End Staff - A staff created using end stone and enderite
Ancient Unknown Weapon - A 30-damage weapon that wears out in 20 uses

Biome:
Red Taiga - A taiga but...red

Blocks:
Ores of all materials (Might not generate - will get fixed later)
Blocks of all materials (uses 9)
Bomb - a stronger TNT - made with 8 iron ingots with uranium in the center

Dimensions:
The Merge - Some overworld biomes and nether biomes with a nether format (MAY CRASH GAME)
Merge Igniter: Made with stone and volgurite

## More features will come soon, so stay tuned!
We are starting off small but we'll increase the size, so some things will be glitchy

**Ore generation only works for Volgurite and Uranium for now, so sooner or later I will allow generation for Nether Diamond and Enderite**
